summary: FAIL, on one regression and one missed card. 7 of 8 at par. The floor gate really does read 0 clips on all 8 base GLBs, but art/tools/clip_floor_fix.py broke Ervet's dash: at the landing the right leg flips from trailing to forward for f15-19, then snaps back 0.995 m in one 30 Hz frame at f20 (was 0.200). The gate cannot see this, because it only measures height. Ervet re-scores 7.4 until that clip is fixed. Separately, lisvel_almanac's splash shows a featureless pale face oval, head turned away, against the engineer's 'face readable' (true of the portrait only). Everything else holds on sheets I re-rendered: named pairs 8.1 or better on all 8, skin deltas, cards 48/0, crown, load 24/24, chains, Vashil steps, Ulkro lumps and recall, Lisvel floor, store gate 32/32. Two fixes remain, neither needing a full rebuild: restore and re-fix Ervet's dash samples, re-render one splash. `npm run content` is still owed before a live match.

items.evidence: art/out/fighters/lisvel/lisvel_almanac_splash.png: the head is turned away and the visible face is a smooth pale oval under the band, with no nose, mouth or lids; the left silhouette has no nose (_harness/_shots/fw_CW5_r3v1_lisvel_splash_heads.png, left; _harness/_shots/fw_CW5_r3v1_almanac_head.png). I hold it at major rather than blocker because the head is seen from behind three-quarter and at full card size it reads as a figure looking up at her arrows. Lead may rule otherwise.
